details.s: Isildur was the oldest son of Elendil and the brother of Anárion. He and Anárion founded and jointly ruled Gondor in the south, while their father dwelt in Arnor in the north.
f: King of Gondor, High King of Arnor and, Gondor, High King of the Dúnedain
